what: P20 step 3: ART's 24 MB, read in AOSP android-11 ART against the Stick's settings. A reading of the source, not a trace.
source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/art/+/refs/heads/android11-release and platform/frameworks/base android11-release; copies kept outside git (raw p20/aosp/)

chain.reads: dalvik.vm.heapminfree/heapmaxfree/heaptargetutilization/foreground-heap-growth-multiplier become -XX:HeapMinFree/-XX:HeapMaxFree/-XX:HeapTargetUtilization/-XX:ForegroundHeapGrowthMultiplier, only when the property is set

outside low-memory mode the multiplier is the option + kExtraDefaultHeapGrowthMultiplier, which is 1.0 when kUseReadBarrier (the concurrent copying collector): 2.0 + 1.0 = 3.0. Low-memory mode (-XX:LowMemoryMode, from ro.config.low_ram) would use 1.0; the Stick does not set it
HeapGrowthMultiplier() is that 3.0 while the process cares about pause times (foreground), else 1.0
after a non-sticky (full) GC: delta = used x (1/0.75 - 1) = used/3; grow = min(delta, max_free 8 MB), then max(grow, min_free 512 KB); target = used + grow x 3
after a sticky (young) GC the target only shrinks, to used + max_free x 3, when that is below the current target

answer: For survivors of 24 MB or more, used/3 >= 8 MB, so grow = 8 MB and the headroom is 8 MB x 3 = 24 MB, fixed: it does not scale with the survivors. Below 24 MB of survivors it would scale (used/3 x 3 = used). In the background (multiplier 1.0) it would be 8 MB. The 192 MB growth limit caps the footprint.
checks: P18/P19: 24 MB after every logged full GC in 7 runs read here and all 5 of P18, survivors 41-59 MB (survivors.json, P18 gc-headroom.json)
P20: the explicit GCs of am dumpheap -g read 46MB/70MB, 48MB/72MB, 46MB/70MB and 51MB/75MB: +24 MB after an explicit full GC too
soWhat: Every MB of survivors cut lowers the footprint the Java heap refills to by one MB; the 24 MB above it is set by system properties the app does not own (and this run may not change).
